mission_01: Congratulations! You have successfully applied SMOTE to balance an imbalanced dataset. You learned how SMOTE generates synthetic minority class samples by interpolating between neighboring points in feature space. The class distribution changed from heavily imbalanced (90:10) to perfectly balanced (50:50). SMOTE is one of the most widely used techniques for handling class imbalance in classification problems. It is available through the imbalanced-learn library and integrates seamlessly with scikit-learn pipelines. Remember to apply SMOTE only to the training data, never to the test set, to avoid data leakage.
